convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for Donchian_Channels_System indicator and depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for position open/close logic, money management, and utility functions (CIsNewBar, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, BuyPositionClose, etc.)

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds for signal timestamp
min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation

other_exits: Opposite Donchian signal triggers close of existing position (buy signal closes sell, sell signal closes buy)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum determines sizing: LOT=fixed lot size (0.1), FREEMARGIN/BALANCE/LOSSFREEMARGIN/LOSSBALANCE=fraction of margin/balance (MM=0.1 means 10% of selected base)

custom_logic_notes: Entry uses Donchian_Channels_System custom indicator buffers: buffer 8 (2-element copy from SignalBar) where Col[1] is the direction flag (>2=up, <2=down) and Col[0] is a color/style index (<3=buy allowed, >1=sell allowed). Signal is evaluated on bar SignalBar (default=1, previous bar). When SignalBar=0, signal is checked every tick. Recount flag retries signal read on CopyBuffer failure. UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime are constructed from SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + TimeShiftSec for trade identification via TradeAlgorithms.mqh. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose are boolean gates that can disable entry/exit independently.
python_conversion_notes: Requires reimplementation of Donchian_Channels_System custom indicator logic (need source of the indicator .mq5 file to replicate buffer 8 calculation). TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, CIsNewBar, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory) must be reimplemented in Python. Position sizing has 5 modes (LOT, FREEMARGIN, BALANCE, LOSSFREEMARGIN, LOSSBALANCE) that require broker-aware margin calculations. Signal logic depends on two buffer values from the custom indicator - the direction threshold (>2 or <2) and color index (<3 or >1) must be understood from the indicator source. SL/TP values of 1000/2000 pips are very large, suggesting these are in points not pips - verify digit adjustment at conversion time.
